Our AI research lab has been running several agents simultaneously for the past few months, and the filesystem has become a complete mess. Files are scattered everywhere — things that should be private ended up in shared folders, scripts landed in the wrong places, temporary junk is sitting in the knowledge base, and someone was apparently editing files inside the archive directly.

We need you to do a full governance audit of the /workspace directory using our multi-agent filesystem governance policy (see SKILL.md). For every file you find, decide where it belongs and why.

Please produce a file called `governance_decisions.json` that documents your decision for each file. The file should cover all the files currently in the workspace and explain what you decided to do with each one.
